_comment: Copy to inferd.json (or point CANVAS_INFERD_CONFIG at it) to set the server-wide default inference backends. Users can override any space from the web UI; resolution is built-in default <- this file <- per-user config. Absent = CPU-local ONNX text (bge-small-en-v1.5) + CLIP images (Xenova/clip-vit-base-patch32). `providers` contains connection details, `spaces` selects the provider and model for each modality, and `rules` routes content into spaces. Provider TYPES are onnx/clip/blip (local, in-process) and openai (every remote backend - Ollama, vLLM, TEI, infinity and OpenAI all speak the same embeddings dialect). Built-in provider IDS you can reference without declaring: onnx, clip, blip, ollama (http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1) and vllm (http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1). `match.contentType` accepts an exact string, a `type/*` prefix, or an explicit `/regex/flags`. Changing a space's model or dimensions creates a separate Lance table and ledger, so the previous model remains available until explicitly removed.
_providers_comment: Only needed for a backend that is not one of the built-in ids. To use a local Ollama or vLLM, skip this block entirely and point a space at "provider": "ollama" or "vllm". A legacy "type": "ollama" with a "host" still loads: it is rewritten to the openai provider against that host.
_rules_comment: Optional. Omit to keep built-in routing: notes, emails, and text files to text; images to image.
_summarize_comment: Optional. Image captions default to SmolVLM-500M-Instruct in the local transformers.js worker, disabled until enabled here or in the UI. Enable and POST /workspaces/:id/inferd/summarize/images. `task` (caption|instruct|florence2) is inferred from the model id; `prompt` only applies to an instruct model.
